question: Notion task 区间1.618测试 method 13: does resting order-book depth in front of the move at the touch judge whether the 1618 holds?
primary_hypothesis: Larger book_1pct (more resting notional opposing the move within 1 percent) -> higher validity; later AUC one-sided permutation p<0.01.
success_criterion: Model on book_1pct and book_2pct trained before split: later AUC>=0.55, early-threshold top30 percent validity>=38.2 and mean R>0, week-stratified p<0.01.
limitations: Binance bookDepth is a ~30s cumulative depth snapshot, not the full book or queue; spoofable; 15m labels; fee 0.
